title: Observe authoring beyond the synchronous timeout

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Observe authoring beyond the synchronous timeout
steps.payload: Describe project.demo.long_write. Start a 60-second job with gate enforce and a unique key. Call status immediately, then 10-second waits until terminal. Repeat identical start, and try the same key with seconds:59. Record start latency, phases after 55 seconds, total elapsed, response sizes and number of calls. Repeat terminal status/wait/start and compare checkpoint and result.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: One job and one write; changed arguments conflict.
Wait timeout leaves execution running; terminal gate passes with one retained checkpoint/validation.
Compare the measured >55-second operation to the documented 55-second synchronous cap; do not replay uncertain mutations.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
